title: Artificial Intelligence Environmental Impacts Act of 2026
action: Referred to the Committee on Science, Space, and Technology, and in addition to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
summary: The Artificial Intelligence Environmental Impacts Act of 2026 establishes rules to measure and reduce the environmental footprint of AI systems, requiring companies to report on energy use and carbon emissions. It also offers incentives for developing greener AI technologies and sets penalties for companies that do not meet the new environmental standards.

title: Stop AI Price Gouging and Wage Fixing Act of 2025
action: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committees on the Judiciary, and Education and Workforce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
summary: The Stop AI Price Gouging and Wage Fixing Act of 2025 is a proposed law aimed at preventing artificial intelligence companies from exploiting consumers through excessively high prices and from manipulating labor markets by setting unfair wages. It seeks to enforce transparency in AI pricing and ensure that wages in AI‑driven sectors remain fair and competitive.

title: FARM AI Act of 2026
action: Referred to the House Committee on Agriculture.
summary: The FARM AI Act of 2026 is a proposed law designed to regulate the use of artificial intelligence in the agricultural sector. It seeks to establish standards for safety, transparency, and data privacy for AI‑driven farming technologies, ensuring they benefit farmers while protecting consumers and the environment.

title: Unleashing AI Innovation in Financial Services Act
action: Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 619.
summary: The Unleashing AI Innovation in Financial Services Act is a proposed law designed to accelerate the adoption of artificial intelligence within the banking and financial sector. It establishes regulatory frameworks and incentives to ensure responsible use of AI, balancing innovation with consumer protection and market integrity.

title: Unleashing AI Innovation in Financial Services Act
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.
summary: The Unleashing AI Innovation in Financial Services Act aims to boost the use of AI in banking and other financial services while ensuring customers stay protected. It sets out rules and oversight to make sure AI tools are safe, fair, and transparent.

title: Artificial Intelligence and Innovation Talent Act
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.
summary: The Artificial Intelligence and Innovation Talent Act seeks to boost the United States' AI capabilities by investing in education, training, and research to develop a skilled workforce. The law also encourages collaboration between industry, academia, and government to foster innovation and maintain global competitiveness.

title: No AI Data Centers on Federal Lands Act
action: Referred to the House Committee on Natural Resources.
summary: The No AI Data Centers on Federal Lands Act would prohibit the construction or operation of AI data centers on lands owned by the federal government. It aims to protect federal resources and prevent potential environmental and security impacts from large AI infrastructure on public property.

title: K–12 AI Literacy and Readiness Act of 2026
action: Ordered to be Reported (Amended) by the Yeas and Nays: 18 - 15.
summary: The K–12 AI Literacy and Readiness Act of 2026 seeks to equip students from kindergarten through high school with foundational knowledge about artificial intelligence, including how to use and critically evaluate AI tools. It also establishes a framework for schools to develop curricula, train educators, and ensure students are prepared for the increasing presence of AI in society and the workforce.

title: K–12 AI Literacy and Readiness Act of 2026
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.
summary: The K–12 AI Literacy and Readiness Act of 2026 aims to embed AI understanding and skills into school curricula from kindergarten through 12th grade. It establishes standards, training, and resources for teachers and students to prepare them for responsible and informed use of AI technologies.

title: China AI Power Report Act
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Foreign Relations.
summary: The China AI Power Report Act requires companies and organizations to submit regular reports on the use and impact of AI technology, focusing on transparency, ethical guidelines, and compliance with national regulations. The act aims to monitor AI development, ensure responsible deployment, and promote accountability across industry sectors.

title: CREATE AI Act of 2025
action: Ordered to be Reported in the Nature of a Substitute (Amended) by the Yeas and Nays: 29 - 0.
summary: The CREATE AI Act of 2025 is designed to regulate artificial intelligence systems, ensuring they are safe, transparent, and accountable. It sets out standards and oversight mechanisms that developers and users must follow to protect public interests and promote responsible AI use.

title: A bill to provide for the delivery of artificial intelligence functional bills of materials, and for other purposes.
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Armed Services.
summary: This bill proposes that artificial‑intelligence developers produce detailed functional bills of materials, documenting each component and dependency of their systems to promote transparency. It also contains additional provisions for regulatory oversight and other AI‑related purposes.

title: Understanding AI in the Classroom Act
action: Referred to the House Committee on Science, Space, and Technology.
summary: The Understanding AI in the Classroom Act aims to clarify how artificial intelligence tools can be responsibly integrated into educational settings, providing guidelines for teachers and schools. It also establishes standards for data privacy, curriculum alignment, and teacher training to ensure AI supports learning without compromising student welfare.

title: Children's Artificial Intelligence Toy Safety Act of 2026
action: Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation. Ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably.
summary: The Children’s Artificial Intelligence Toy Safety Act of 2026 is a U.S. law that establishes safety standards and regulations for AI-powered toys sold to children. It requires manufacturers to conduct thorough safety testing, label products clearly, and comply with federal and state consumer protection regulations to ensure that such toys are safe and appropriate for young users.

title: Expressing the sense of the House of Representatives that every American and community impacted by the construction or operation of an artificial intelligence data center should have the right to transparency and local autonomy.
action: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committee on the Judiciary, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
summary: The House of Representatives says that every American—and especially the communities near a new AI data center—must be kept fully informed about how the center is built and run. They also want those communities to have the power to decide locally what is best for them.

title: Responsible Artificial Intelligence for Veterans Act of 2026
action: Referred to the House Committee on Veterans' Affairs.
summary: The Responsible Artificial Intelligence for Veterans Act of 2026 seeks to ensure that AI technologies used in veteran services are developed, deployed, and monitored responsibly. It establishes guidelines, oversight mechanisms, and accountability standards to protect veterans' rights and safety when interacting with AI systems.

title: Safeguarding Against Fabricated Exploitation Through Artificial Intelligence Act of 2026
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs.
summary: The Safeguarding Against Fabricated Exploitation Through Artificial Intelligence Act of 2026 is designed to protect individuals and organizations from false claims of AI misuse that could harm their reputation or lead to unjust legal actions. It establishes clear standards and penalties for companies that spread fabricated evidence of AI exploitation, ensuring accountability and preventing unwarranted damage.

title: Research and Oversight of AI in Courts Act of 2026
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.
summary: This act establishes a framework for studying how artificial intelligence is used in the judicial system and sets up oversight bodies to monitor its impact. It aims to ensure AI tools in courts are transparent, accountable, and used to improve fairness and efficiency.

title: Decoupling America's Artificial Intelligence Capabilities from China Act of 2025
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.
summary: This act seeks to reduce the United States’ dependence on Chinese AI technology by restricting the import and use of Chinese AI hardware and software. It aims to strengthen domestic AI research and development through increased funding, incentives, and regulatory measures.

title: Preventing Algorithmic Collusion Act of 2025
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.
summary: The Preventing Algorithmic Collusion Act of 2025 is a U.S. law designed to stop businesses from using AI algorithms to secretly coordinate prices or other market practices that would harm competition. It requires companies to monitor, disclose, and mitigate any collusive behavior in automated decision systems, ensuring that algorithms do not conspire to manipulate markets or disadvantage consumers.

title: Expanding AI Voices Act
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.
summary: The Expanding AI Voices Act proposes to broaden the range of perspectives and applications of AI in society. It aims to encourage more inclusive and diverse AI development, ensuring that a wider array of voices and viewpoints are considered in the creation and deployment of AI systems.

title: Homestake AI Act of 2026
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.
summary: The Homestake AI Act of 2026 establishes new federal guidelines for the development, deployment, and use of artificial intelligence, aiming to protect public safety, privacy, and ensure transparency. It requires companies and organizations to conduct risk assessments, disclose AI system capabilities, and maintain accountability measures for AI applications across various industries.
